main_body: A dark vertical column shaft (rows ~16-40) with a pale left strip and three gold ring ornaments, capped by grey blocks at the top (rows 8-15) and bottom (rows 40-47).
top_band: Light grey band at rows ~9-12 under a near-black outline at row 8. It is a flat rounded-rectangle cap, not an ellipse, and it merges into a darker grey front band at rows 13-15.
evidence: The cap reads as a face-on horizontal band, like the red 'flat band cap' column in the guide. It has no ellipse or foreshortened top surface and no distinct front-edge line. The shaft below is a flat face-on panel with painted rings, so no horizontal surface is visible from above. The top end is not a convincing top surface.

style.evidence: The shaft is a large flat near-black fill with only a thin lighter strip and flat gold ring shapes. The caps have about 3 grey steps and no grain, speckle or per-stone shading. A uniform near-black outline surrounds the piece, giving the sticker look. Tiles carry only about 2-4 colours, far below the stall and well references.
